sections.heading: Troy Deeney’s Insights on the Premier League
sections.text: Known for his combative style on the pitch and sharp insights off it, Troy Deeney has transitioned into one of the more forthright pundits in the football world. Each week, this former Watford captain and talisman takes on the unenviable task of selecting a team of the week, highlighting those players who delivered outstanding performances. This feature, hosted on BBC Sport, gives fans a chance to reflect on the weekend’s matches while sparking debates about the Premier League’s top-performing stars.
